scripts.build: python3 -c "import os; os.makedirs('dist', exist_ok=True); import shutil; shutil.copy('src/utils.py', 'dist/utils.py'); print('utils build complete')"
scripts.clean: python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.rmtree('dist', ignore_errors=True); print('utils clean complete')"

scripts.build: sh -c 'if command -v go >/dev/null; then go build ./...; else echo "[worker] go not installed, skipping native build"; fi'
scripts.test: sh -c 'if command -v go >/dev/null; then go test ./...; else echo "[worker] go not installed, skipping tests"; fi'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'if command -v go >/dev/null; then go vet ./...; else echo "[worker] go not installed, skipping lint"; fi'
scripts.clean: sh -c 'rm -rf bin && echo worker clean complete'
